name: Example: Evaluating Repeated Integrals Over Non-Rectangular Domains
worked_solution:
First, we evaluate the inner integral by integrating with respect to $z,$ treating $x$ and $y$ as constants: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{x}{\int }_{0}^{3-x-y}x\,dz\,dy\,dx & ={\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{x}[{\int }_{0}^{3-x-y}x\,dz]dy\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{x}x\cdot [z]_{z=0}^{z=3-x-y}\,dy\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{x}x(3-x-y)\,dy\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{x}3x-{x}^{2}-xy\,dy\,dx\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we evaluate the inner integral by integrating with respect to $y,$ treating $x$ as a constant: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{x}3x-{x}^{2}-xy\,dy\,dx & ={\int }_{0}^{2}[{\int }_{0}^{x}3x-{x}^{2}-xy\,dy]dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}{[(3x-{x}^{2})y-\frac{1}{2}x{y}^{2}]}_{y=0}^{y=x}\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}(3x-{x}^{2})(x-0)-\frac{1}{2}x({x}^{2}-0)\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}3{x}^{2}-{x}^{3}-\frac{1}{2}{x}^{3}\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}3{x}^{2}-\frac{3}{2}{x}^{3}\,dx\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we integrate with respect to $x{:}$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{2}3{x}^{2}-\frac{3}{2}{x}^{3}\,dx & ={[{x}^{3}-\frac{3}{8}{x}^{4}]}_{x=0}^{x=2} \\  & =8-6 \\  & =2\end{aligned}
$$
